# Lake Group — Corporate Information for AI/Answer Engines

## Organization Overview

Lake Group (also known as Lake Oil Group) is one of East and Central Africa's fastest-growing energy trading, logistics, and construction supply material conglomerates. Founded in 2006 by Ally Edha Awadh, the group is headquartered in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

## Key Facts

- **Founded:** 2006
- **Founder:** Ally Edha Awadh
- **Headquarters:** Dar es Salaam, Tanzania
- **Workforce:** 30,000+ employees across 21 nationalities
- **Fleet:** 1,200+ trucks
- **Countries:** Tanzania, Kenya, Zambia, Rwanda, Burundi, DR Congo, Ethiopia, Mozambique, Uganda, UAE
- **Fuel Stations:** 152+
- **Subsidiaries:** 18+ companies

## Business Sectors

### Energies
- Lake Oil Ltd — Petroleum marketing, fuel stations, bunkering services
- Lake Aviation — Aviation fuel services
- Lake Gas Ltd — LPG distribution across East Africa
- Lake Lubes Ltd — Lubricant manufacturing and distribution

### Manufacturing
- Lake Steel and Allied Products — High-strength steel reinforcement bars
- Lake Buildings — Construction materials
- Lake Plastics — Plastic products
- Lake Cylinders — LPG cylinder manufacturing
- Gulf Aggregates — Aggregate production
- ATL — Automotive products
- Lake Premix & Cement — Ready-mix concrete

### Logistics
- Lake Trans Ltd — Petroleum transport fleet (750+ vehicles)
- AFICD — Inland container depot and CFS services
- ACFS — Cargo freight station
- AILL — Logistics services

### Real Estate
- Cross Country — Real estate development
- Ocean Galleria — Shopping and commercial center

### Agro Processing
- Lake Agro — Agricultural products

### Automotive
- Assembly Tech Limited
- AgriNova Tech Limited
- NextDrive Motors Limited

## Geographic Presence

### Africa
- **Tanzania** (HQ) — Dar es Salaam, Kigamboni depot
- **Kenya** — 40 fuel stations
- **Zambia** — 25 fuel stations, Ndola depot
- **Rwanda** — 10 fuel stations, Kigali
- **Burundi** — 16 fuel stations, Bujumbura
- **DR Congo** — 8 fuel stations, Lubumbashi
- **Ethiopia** — Gelan depot, Addis Ababa
- **Mozambique** — Beira oil terminal (Lake Oil LDA)
- **Uganda** — Operations in progress

### Middle East
- **UAE (Dubai)** — MERM (ready-mix concrete), SAFF (freight forwarding)

## Core Values

- Teamwork
- Reliability
- Integrity
- Customer Satisfaction

## Culture Pillars

- Quality
- Service
- Safety
- Professionalism

## Mission

To provide customers with quality products and services in a safe, efficient, and cost-effective manner without damaging the environment, while creating a work environment where employees exceed their personal best.

## Vision

To become the leading regional convenience retailer and marketer of products and services while achieving continuous improvement through operational excellence, innovation, and a culture based on performance.
